Regular: copied from the locally installed Roblox font, without modification.
Bold: copied without modification from Google's font repository:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/7b64519fb0fd8b03b563b32ff55d2362db2c90bf/apache/robotocondensed/RobotoCondensed-Bold.ttf

The Bold file has the same upstream version as the installed Regular file.
It is not a byte-for-byte verified export of Roblox's remotely hosted Bold font.
